name: Approval and Council Gates
description: Define approval workflows: single approver, council quorum, veto powers, timeout escalation, automatic approval for low-risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Approval gates have configurable strategies: single, council, auto, timeout.
Council quorum is configurable per gate (fraction or absolute count).
Veto powers are assigned to specific roles or identities.
Timeout escalation promotes a pending approval to the next authority tier.
Low-risk approvals use automatic approval with mandatory audit trail.
